history.summary: The Quintet is a 99-yr leasehold (2006) condo in D23 Yew Tee, 4BR 1,571 sqft at $1.78M / $1,133 psf, 480m from Yew Tee MRT. Low PSF and a $1.78M quantum in the liquid band are attractive, but it's an aging 99-yr lease (~79yrs left) in a slow OCR submarket with no URA data attached.
history.rating_rationale: $1,133 psf is genuinely low and $1.78M for a 1,571 sqft 4BR near Yew Tee MRT (480m) appeals to HDB upgraders — broad buyer pool in band, and it sits on the value frontier. Offsetting: 99-yr lease from 2006 leaves ~79 years (lease decay clock running), D23 Yew Tee is a slow-appreciating OCR fringe, and no URA txn/appreciation data is provided. A fair value-buy for an upgrader, balanced for investment.
red_flags: 99-yr leasehold from 2006 — ~79 years left, lease decay accelerates over a 5-7yr hold
D23 Yew Tee is a slow OCR submarket with limited catalysts
No URA appreciation/transaction data to verify the rate
Large 1,571 sqft leasehold unit dilutes per-sqft appreciation
catalysts: 480m to Yew Tee NS5 MRT — strong transit proximity
$1.78M for a big 4BR appeals to HDB upgraders; on the value frontier
Low $1,133 psf entry with quantum in the liquid band
